copies.requirement: Classify record and relations before any erasure. Clinical documents and identity necessary for custody are retained with restricted access.
Account closure/revocation is separate from clinical custody. Never delete Auth identities by cascade without reviewing clinical references.
Delete bytes through the Storage API, verify absence and keep independent restore exclusions. Never treat SQL metadata deletion as byte deletion.
Verify the applicable project plan, event/issue scope, shared-user impact and deletion receipt before erasure. No clinical content in new events.
Person deletion is asynchronous: verify deletion_status and all distinct IDs; event retention windows are not an erasure receipt. Session replay remains disabled.

Provider copies and recipients' mailboxes are separate. Published Resend live email/log retention is 30 days for Free/Pro/Scale, backups 7 days. Verify actual account contract; do not promise recall of delivered mail.
Verify each contracted backup expiry/retirement separately; waiting or a public policy alone is not proof. Supabase database backups exclude Storage bytes.
Encrypted backups need inventory, restricted access, retention review and fresh independent exclusion lists before any recovery.

Review Vercel and Supabase request/runtime logs and exported drains separately from analytics. Verify contracted retention and all exports. GitHub QA artifacts must remain synthetic/sanitized; absence of clinical data is a check, not an assumption.

certification: Source documentation proves provider behavior described publicly, not deletion of Nello's copies. No real clinical records are erased by this policy.
